data.name: Derwin
data.gender_notes: Derwin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Doron' which means 'gift' and 'win' meaning 'friend'. In Norse mythology, Thor is the god of thunder. Therefore, Derwin translates to 'Follower of Thor'. The name Derwin carries the meaning “Follower of Thor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Derwin usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of thor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
